title: Interrupted Key Compaction in LinEra: A Bounded Availability Audit
author: Ezekiel Ologunde
scope: One interrupted core-store compaction makes both retained objects unreadable; a separate single-writer journal comparator preserves retained reads in the tested interruption phases. Forgotten objects remain unreadable. No cryptographic break, physical erasure or production reliability claim.
replay_scope: The earlier 14-member scientific archive was replayed from a clean extraction. The 17-member licensed archive preserves all 12 executable/scientific members byte-for-byte, adds authored licence notices, and updates only replay/manifest metadata. Its 16 listed members verify. The paper describes the original scientific archive.
